SEVEN capitula, five quiz questions. h28 and h29 are represented in the
AEGYPTUS phase instead: the five quiz pictures are deliberately chosen
from five different families — grain, a camel caravan, a bare stone room,
grapes and a throne — so no two can be confused at 96 px, and h28's and
h29's cards are robed men in the same desert as three earlier ones.
quizKey carries the same {q, a} pair per row that r03-r07, l3 and l4 use:
rules.php stores the question word and the vocab key that must be picked,
so grading never depends on the order the client drew the options in. For
a word -> pick-the-image quiz the answer IS the question word, and
`correct` is always 0 against the boss.quiz order in
content/historia-l5.js.
l5 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases().
